scope: Read-only existing workflow and artifact-validator review; no artifacts built, downloaded, signed, uploaded, installed or qualified by this review.

ordinary_native_wheel.trigger: Unconditional pull_request and push on main/release3.2 plus manual dispatch
ordinary_native_wheel.identity: All four install a built wheel, clear development overrides and run actual bundled-runtime identity plus default-auto checks.
ordinary_native_wheel.identity_probe_limit: Own docstring and result explicitly say cross_release_upgrade_rollback and signing_qualification not_exercised. Same artifact is restored after local mutation; not a distinct release rollback.
ordinary_native_wheel.unix_only: Linux and both Macs run the standalone installed Pi-output and small installed-SLO wave. They run validate_release_artifacts on their own platform with explicit Windows omission text.
ordinary_native_wheel.windows: Identity, installed command-control-lock and default-auto probes; Pi cases are inside default-auto only. No standalone Pi-output probe, Unix-style artifact-validator JSON or installed SLO wave.
ordinary_native_wheel.archive_limit: Normal CI logs may report wheel/runtime/source/version/rule digests; independent downloaded-byte verification must be separately recorded.

actual_checks: Explicit canonical version and full lower-hex source/rule identity
Bounded regular wheel/archive metadata and exact native manifest key set
Exact platform-to-target map, package/source/rule equality and actual member digest/size
Pure hol-guard wheel plus exactly the explicitly requested native platform set
Windows omission requires explicit text; a validated Windows wheel forbids that waiver
existing_local_admission.all_platform_use: Pass all four --platform values; do not use three-platform default or waiver to claim four-platform acceptance.
existing_local_admission.optional_records: Policy identity, SBOM and provenance arguments are optional. validate_provenance parses bounded JSON/JSONL records and checks expected structural keys; that alone does not cryptographically verify signer, subject/source binding or provenance.
existing_local_admission.exact_aggregate: scripts/verify_native_runtime_release.py validate-local checks the exact four-native target set and its manifests/runtime hashes. Existing --artifact-set full additionally checks the complete Guard distribution set; neither command publishes.

native_build_selection: Same-repo PR with publish-testpypi-canary label and canary channel
publishing_workflows.canary: Installed PR canary additionally requires PR_CANARY_PUBLISHING_ENABLED and depends on actual TestPyPI publication. It is an external publication route, not necessary to execute offline wheel admission.
publishing_workflows.release_attestation: Main/alpha release jobs use actions/attest-build-provenance and materialize a bundle. These jobs are conditional release paths with write/OIDC/attestation permissions; normal PR success does not mean they ran.
publishing_workflows.current_authorization: No publish workflow, release label, external registry upload, branch authority change or release dispatch is performed by this review.

frozen_sidecars.desktop: Existing signed Core route is macOS ARM only, trusted main, protected core-alpha-desktop environment, actual configured Apple signing/notarization and an already published stable Core source/wheel.
pipeline: Verify the published wheel provenance/source before staging native runtime and manifest
Sign native runtime and refresh manifest runtime hash/size
Build PyInstaller sidecar, reseal packaged native manifest, sign outer executable
Verify archived runtime digest/size and signing identity; notarize and verify final exported asset
limits: The observed frozen verifier validates embedded schema/runtime hash/size and optional TeamIdentifier; final package/source/version/rule linkage still needs retained admitted input and transformation records.
Unsigned MDM fixture workflow covers macOS/Windows packaging and explicitly expects unhealthy unsigned status; it is not a signed candidate or native rollout proof.
No signing credentials or protected environment configuration were inspected by this review; available authority is not inferred from workflow names.

concrete_remaining.action: Complete reviewed combined implementation and scope-appropriate validation, then freeze its exact source and declare selected artifact versions and targets.

Build exact baseline and candidate wheels with locked dependencies and declared toolchains; retain actual artifact bytes/digests, native capabilities and manifest/source/rule/version links. Verify the complete four-platform set offline without a Windows waiver.

Use each actual installed wheel interpreter and bundled runtime for no-environment launcher, aliases/source references, Watch/availability and approval controls. Keep original registered executable/argv proof separate from HTTP adapters.

For each selected signed/frozen distribution, retain pre-sign, signed and packaged identities and execute the relevant existing refresh/seal/verify paths with actual authorized signing context. Do not substitute an unsigned fixture.

Run original version/generation update/downgrade/rollback and in-progress-request controls using distinct actual artifacts, then original complete performance/resource/receipt/recovery qualification and concrete canary evidence.
